exams.name: USMLE (United States Medical Licensing Examination)
exams.notes: All three parts required; conditions and requirements for completion established by board rule. FLEX, COMLEX, national boards, Canadian licentiate exam, or board-approved state-constructed exam are alternatives.
exams.quote: Has successfully completed all three (3) parts of the USMLE, national boards, the FLEX, a board approved, state constructed licensing examination, the examination by the licentiate of the medical council of Canada or the COMLEX

exams.name: COMLEX (Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination)
exams.notes: Alternative to USMLE for osteopathic applicants
exams.jurisdiction: national (National Board of Osteopathic Medical Examiners)
exams.quote: "COMLEX" means the comprehensive osteopathic medical licensing examination, administered by the national board of osteopathic medical examiners;

interval_years.quote: A license to practice medicine, subject to annual renewal;

required.quote: A licensee may renew his license each year by submitting a renewal application containing information required by the board, accompanied by proof of compliance with and fulfillment of continuing medical education requirements of the board

value: 1 hour of CE related to responsible prescribing of controlled substances or treatment of substance abuse disorders every two years (for licensees registered with the board of pharmacy to dispense controlled substances)
topical_requirements.quote: The board shall require licensees who are registered with the board of pharmacy to dispense a controlled substance in this state to complete one (1) hour of continuing education related to the responsible prescribing of controlled substances or the treatment of substance abuse disorders every two (2) years.

available.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into on behalf of this state with all other states legally joining in the compact

requirements.value: Wyoming participates in the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact, which provides an expedited pathway for eligible physicians to obtain licensure in multiple member states. Eligibility requires graduation from an accredited medical school, passing USMLE/COMLEX within 3 attempts, completion of ACGME/AOA-approved GME, specialty certification, a full unrestricted license in a principal state, and no criminal history, disciplinary actions, or controlled substance permit revocations.
requirements.quote: The compact creates another pathway for licensure and does not otherwise change a state's existing medical practice act.

title_protection.quote: Attaches the title of M.D., D.O., P.A., physician, surgeon, osteopathic physician or osteopathic surgeon, doctor, physician assistant or any other words, letters or abbreviations or any combination thereof when used in the conduct of any occupation or profession pertaining to the prevention, diagnosis or treatment of human disease or condition

scope_protection.quote: Any person engaged in the practice of medicine or aiding and abetting another in the practice of medicine without a license granted by the board is guilty of a misdemeanor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or renewing a license by bribery, fraud, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Renewing, obtaining or attempting to obtain or renew a license by bribery, fraud or misrepresentation;

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonating another licensee or practicing medicine under a false or assumed name;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false or misleading statements regarding the licensee's skill or the efficacy of treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making false or misleading statements regarding the licensee's skill or the efficacy or value of his treatment or remedy for a human disease, injury, deformity, ailment, pregnancy or delivery of infants;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting another person to use the licensee's diploma, license, or certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting or allowing any person to use his diploma, license or certificate of registration;

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of or pleading guilty or nolo contendere to a felony or any crime that is a felony under Wyoming law in any jurisdiction;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine by an unlicensed person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine by a person not licensed by the board;

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or attempting to violate or assist in the violation of any provision of this chapter or any other applicable provision of law;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeatedly prescribing or administering narcotic/scheduled drugs to a known abuser
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except as permitted by law, repeatedly prescribing or administering, selling or supplying any drug legally classified as a narcotic, addicting or scheduled drug to a known abuser;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeatedly prescribing narcotic/scheduled drugs to a parent, spouse, child, or self
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeatedly prescribing, selling, supplying or administering any drug legally classified as a narcotic, addicting or scheduled drug to a parent, spouse or child of the applicant or licensee, or to himself;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presigning blank prescription forms
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Presigning blank prescription forms;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to properly guard against the spread of contagious, infectious, or communicable diseases
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing or refusing to properly guard against the spread of contagious, infectious or communicable diseases;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to appropriately supervise nonphysicians to whom medical responsibilities were delegated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to appropriately supervise nonphysicians to whom the licensee has delegated medical responsibilities;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating responsibilities to a person not qualified by training, experience, or licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating responsibilities to a person who is not qualified by training, experience or licensure;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Manifest incapacity to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A manifest incapacity to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical or mental disability rendering the practice of medicine unsafe
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Possession of any physical or mental disability including deterioration due to aging which renders the practice of medicine unsafe;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of a drug or intoxicant rendering the licensee unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of a drug or intoxicant to such a degree as to render the licensee unable to practice medicine or surgery with reasonable skill and safety to patients;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine below the applicable standard of care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing medicine below the applicable standard of care, regardless of causation or damage;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to submit to informal interview or mental/physical/medical competency examination when properly requested
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to submit to an informal interview or a mental, physical or medical competency examination following a proper request by the board pursuant to W.S. 33-26-403;

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Upon proper request by the board, failure or refusal to produce documents or other information relevant to any investigation conducted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any board rule or regulation;

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acquiring or attempting or conspiring to acquire any drug classified as a narcotic, addicting or scheduled drug by fraud or deception;

definition_quote.value: Practicing medicine means any person who in any manner: (A) Advertises, holds out, or represents to the public that he is authorized to practice medicine in this state; or (B) Offers or undertakes to prevent, diagnose, correct or treat, in any manner, by any means, method or device, any human disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect or abnormal physical or mental condition, injury, deformity or ailment, including the management of pregnancy and parturition; or (C) Attaches the title of M.D., D.O., P.A., physician, surgeon, osteopathic physician or osteopathic surgeon, doctor, physician assistant...; or (D) Practices osteopathy; or (E) Offers or undertakes to prescribe, order, give or administer drugs which can only be obtained by prescription according to law; or (F) Renders a determination of medical necessity or appropriateness of proposed treatment.
definition_quote.quote: "Practicing medicine" means any person who in any manner: (A) Advertises, holds out, or represents to the public that he is authorized to practice medicine in this state; or (B) Offers or undertakes to prevent, diagnose, correct or treat, in any manner, by any means, method or device, any human disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect or abnormal physical or mental condition, injury, deformity or ailment, including the management of pregnancy and parturition;

Controlled substance prescribing requires 1 hour of CE every 2 years for those registered with the board of pharmacy to dispense.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must be certified by the E.C.F.M.G. (Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates) in lieu of graduation from an LCME or AOA accredited school. Alternatively, a 'fifth pathway' (an academic year of supervised clinical education from an LCME-accredited medical school) is available for students who studied at a foreign medical school and met specified examination requirements.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into on behalf of this state with all other states legally joining in the compact

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician assistant may collaborate with or refer to the appropriate member of a healthcare team as indicated by the condition of the patient and the education, experience and competence of the physician assistant and current standard of care. The degree of collaboration shall be determined at the practice level, which may include decisions made by the employer, group, hospital service or the credentialing and privileging systems.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: A physician assistant may not prescribe schedule I drugs. A physician assistant may prescribe schedule II, III, IV, or V drugs. A physician assistant may dispense prepackaged medications in rural clinics when pharmacy services are not physically available.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician assistant shall not prescribe schedule I drugs as defined by W.S. 35-7-1013 through 35-7-1014. A physician assistant may prescribe schedule II, III, IV or V drugs as defined by W.S. 35-7-1015 through 35-7-1022.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Each licensee shall report to the board any personal injury or wrongful death claim made because of any alleged act, error or omission of the licensee. Failure to report the claim shall be grounds for disciplinary action by the board.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Each health care entity shall report: (i) Any action it takes against a licensee on the grounds that the licensee is impaired, or has engaged in conduct constituting a ground for disciplinary action in W.S. 33-26-402; (ii) Any action that: (A) Adversely affects the clinical privileges of a licensee for a period exceeding thirty (30) days;

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: Participate in and contract with a program or programs to assist in the return to practice of licensees who have exhibited disruptive behaviors, substance dependence or abuse or are suffering from physical or mental impairment;

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: The board may order a licensee to undergo one (1) or more mental, physical or medical competency examinations by examiners deemed appropriate by the board if it has reasonable cause to believe that the licensee may be impaired.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: An administrative medicine license for physicians not providing patient care, provided the qualifications for and the conditions of this license shall be established by rule.
